title: Deepana & Pachana
description: Kindling digestive fire (Agni) and digesting toxins (Ama) through light diet and specific herbs.

title: Internal Snehana (Oleation)
description: Consuming medicated ghee or oil in increasing doses for 3-7 days to lubricate tissues and loosen toxins.

title: External Snehana (Abhyanga)
description: Full body warm oil massage to move loosened doshas toward the gastrointestinal tract.

title: Svedana (Fomentation/Sweating)
description: Therapeutic heat therapy (steam) immediately following external snehana to open channels (srotas).
